name: Steve Haines
reason: A bodyworker offering Biodynamic Craniosacral Therapy and TRE treatments (London and Geneva), whose books are titled on conditions (Pain Is Really Strange, Anxiety Is Really Strange, Trauma Is Really Strange); main work is clinical bodywork sold on conditions (health rule). His old site stevehaines.net now carries an unrelated essay-writing page, so no own site was found for a contact or base.
